_comment: ControlNet (mask-conditional) training on the POOLED corpus. The UNet and the conditioning vector stay pooled; only the ControlNet is trained, and only on the volumes that carry a tumour mask. build_controlnet_file_list drops every subject absent from the mask CSV, so pointing this at the pooled embeddings with the BraTS seg CSV restricts training to BraTS (3,378 volumes = 1,126 subjects x T1/T2/FLAIR) without a separate corpus. One mask serves all modalities of a subject: the segmentation is defined on the subject, not the scan.
_comment_why: brats gen inception FID is 75.8 (T1) against ukb_T1's 8.9, while brats RECONSTRUCTS better than the corpus average (PSNR 33.7-34.0 vs 32.2-32.4). The VAE handles tumours; the diffusion prior does not. BraTS is also the only cohort whose conditioning is nearly empty - sex, age and cdrsb are all missing for every volume, leaving modality + dx=tumor, i.e. one categorical bit to specify a tumour's location, size, shape and enhancement. This supplies the missing spatial variable.
